LanguageData.DeltaV_TractorBatchCargoTip: Shows the first selected tractor's cargo filter. Changing it copies the complete displayed filter to all selected tractors. Opening this tab does not change their settings.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TractorLivingDesc: Automatically recover people, animals and mechanoids allowed by the pawn filter. Corpses use the cargo filter independently of this toggle.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TractorPawnFilterDesc: Choose which combinations of faction relationship and pawn type can be automatically recovered. Relationships are relative to this device's faction. Hostile pawns are excluded by default.
